goal: 修复 Pi session-start hook 注入超大 Mainline context 导致模型 prompt 超限

summary.title: 限制 Pi hook 上下文注入体积
summary.what: 将 session-start 的完整 status/sync JSON 改为保留 active intent、authority、计数和下一步命令的紧凑摘要；对大型 turns、uncovered、proposals、suggestions、actionable items 与任意 sync 数组设置条数/字符串限制和 omitted 计数；在通用 renderer 增加 32KiB/16KiB 硬预算，并在 Pi extension 增加 stdout、单段 context、合并 context 三层防御性上限。新增大型 fixture，验证预算、关键信息保留和省略正文不泄露。
summary.why: Pi 会把 hook 返回的 systemPromptAppend 拼入模型 system prompt。大型 active intent 曾让 session-start 返回约 6.7MB 文本，使空白新会话也超过 1M token 上下文。需要默认按需加载详情，并在 renderer 与宿主 extension 两端建立确定性安全边界。
summary.user_goal: 修复 Pi session-start hook 注入超大 Mainline context 导致模型 prompt 超限

decisions.point: session-start 应注入多少 Mainline 状态
decisions.chose: 默认注入紧凑、可执行的状态摘要，省略大型历史集合并提供 omitted 数量与 mainline status/preflight/context/show 命令
decisions.rationale: agent 仍能看到 active intent id/goal、authority stop line 和关键计数，同时避免把完整 turns、diff/file 列表与 uncovered 详情复制进 system prompt
rejected: 继续序列化完整 status/sync JSON
永久卸载 Pi integration 作为长期方案

decisions.point: 上下文预算应在哪一层执行
decisions.chose: 通用 dispatcher renderer 和 Pi extension 双层防护
decisions.rationale: renderer 负责正常情况下的紧凑语义和确定性预算；Pi extension 可防御旧二进制、未来 renderer 回归或异常超大 stdout
rejected: 只依赖 Pi extension 最终截断
只限制当前 status 数组而不设置最终硬上限

decisions.chose: 注入短 warning 和按需查询命令，而不是无提示丢弃或保留任意前缀
decisions.rationale: 让 agent 明确知道详情被省略，并能恢复必要上下文

review_notes: 本次实际产品变更只涉及 4 个 hooks 文件；intent 的旧 base 在 rebase 后让 seal prepare 包同时列出主线新增文件，这些上游文件未被本提交修改，也未纳入 fingerprint。
验证通过：go test ./...；go vet ./...；git diff --check。

真实大型 opencad 仓库复验：修复后 Pi session-start systemPromptAppend 为 3,940 chars / 3,992 bytes，低于 32KiB；修复前记录约 6,723,009 chars。输出保留 active_intent、agent_authority、allowed_boundary、turns_omitted 和 mainline status --json 指引。
尺寸复验与测试失败信息均只记录长度、计数和字段存在性，未输出大型 diff、文件正文或密钥。

architectural_claims: Agent hook context is a bounded summary surface, not a transport for complete repository state.
Detailed Mainline state is loaded on demand through preflight/status/context/show commands.
Host-agent integrations retain an independent defensive size boundary around subprocess output and injected context.
behavioral_changes: session-start status output now preserves active intent identity/goal, branch/head state, coverage counts, authority stop line, suggestions and actionable commands while omitting large nested histories.
Large turns and uncovered details report omitted counts instead of serializing their contents.
Sync arrays and nested values are bounded by collection count, string length and nesting depth.
Session-start and per-prompt rendered contexts are capped at 32KiB and 16KiB respectively with UTF-8-safe deterministic fallback text.
Pi extension caps captured stdout at 256Ki characters and injected/combined Mainline context at 48Ki characters; excess content becomes a compact warning with follow-up commands.

api_changes.signature: Pi hook systemPromptAppend content for session-start and user-prompt-submit

security_implications: Large omitted diff/history strings are no longer copied into model system prompts by default, reducing accidental disclosure and prompt-size denial-of-service exposure.
Pi subprocess stdout capture is bounded to prevent unbounded memory accumulation from malformed or regressed hook output.
migration_notes: Existing managed Pi extensions must be refreshed with mainline hooks install --agent pi to receive the extension-side defensive limits; the dispatcher-side compact output applies immediately when using the updated binary.
